note: Noun-phrase SAM prompts returned no boxes on this dark UI. A point on a bright pixel did. Muse Spark named the regions, and SAM then segmented those boxes.

failures.defect: Shown beside the list on a phone-width cover.
failures.fix: Use one pane on a compact width and open the detail on tap.

shots.name: cover-host-after
shots.observed: One column. Muse Spark reported no layout failure.

shots.name: flat-device
shots.observed: Two panes. That count is right for a wide unfolded screen. The boxes came back on a 0-1000 grid, not source pixels.

failures.defect: Side by side with the list. A tabletop detail should sit below the horizontal fold.
failures.fix: Stack the panes across the horizontal hinge.

shots.name: book-host-before
shots.observed: Two panes, which is the right count. The still does not show a hinge gap. A 45 degree fold on the Z Fold 8 is outside Samsung Flex mode (75-115), so the phone does not report that pose as half-open.
